audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart read 'Skill' on all seven rows; content and packet read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Hwei/Orianna. The late-game row in particular disagreed — the page's own late-game prose says Orianna out-scales you.
audit.why: Hwei out-ranges Command: Attack's 815 early; level 6 is even because Shockwave is a fight tool at only 410 range, not a duel tool; two items onward Orianna's shield utility and Shockwave out-value pure poke, which is what the content layer already said.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to match packet and content, including Orianna on the 2+ items row.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Orianna cooldown or range appeared anywhere, so 'her ball poke gets better' was never tied to a timing.
audit.why: Command: Attack goes from 7s at rank 1 to 3s at rank 5 — the poke spike is the Q rank-ups, not an item. Command: Protect is a flat 9s shield from level 3 onward, and Shockwave is 110/95/80.
audit.corrected: Q's 3s late cooldown, E's flat 9s shield and R's 110s are now stated in winCon, cooldowns, dosFull and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was described only as 'the fight-flipping wombo'. Two concrete facts were absent: Shockwave launches enemies toward the BALL from 410 range (so the ball's position, not Orianna's, is the threat line), and Command: Protect shields the ally it flies to, eating a mark detonation.
audit.why: Riot's R text: the ball unleashes a shockwave launching nearby enemies towards the Ball after a short delay. Riot's E text: the ball attaches to an allied champion, shielding them and damaging enemies it passes through. Every Hwei damage source is a delayed projectile paint, so a 9s shield arriving before the detonation blanks the payoff.
audit.corrected: Stated in tradeBad, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer twice referenced 'her Q dash-back combo' / 'Q-ball combo dash-back trick'. Orianna has no dash in her kit, and wants.foe[2] called the shield her W.
audit.why: Orianna's mobility is zero: Q places the ball, W pulses a speed/slow field around it, E attaches the ball to an ally with a shield. The shield is E (Command: Protect); W is Command: Dissonance.
audit.corrected: Dash references removed and the shield re-labelled Command: Protect.

audit.whatIsWrong: 24 misgender hits, two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets, and breakdown.cooldowns with no digit in it.
audit.why: Orianna is female per champ-gender.js; the bled bullets restate tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: All fixed in the edits below.
